package.name: newick-trees-for-emerge-methanogen-genome-tree-and-methylotrophic-gene-trees-8307c5b7
package.title: Newick Trees for EMERGE methanogen genome tree, and methylotrophic gene trees
package.notes:
Newick trees provided for phylogenomic and phylogenetic analyses from Ellenbogen *et al. *(in prep). The methanogen genome tree ([Newick_tree_for_methanogen_genome_tree.suptree](https://zenodo.org/api/files/ab7737bc-895d-472d-9db1-363b2868fa1d/Newick_tree_for_methanogen_genome_tree.suptree)) was built using an alignment generated with GTDB-Tk v1.5.0 r202, and the tree made using IQ Tree v1.6.12. All other trees are RAxML gene trees built using ProtPipeliner ([https://github.com/TheWrightonLab/Protpipeliner/blob/master/protpipeliner.py](https://github.com/TheWrightonLab/Protpipeliner/blob/master/protpipeliner.py)) to confirm the functional identity of identified methylotrophic genes from methanogens and bacteria. The names of the Newick trees correspond to relevant gene groupings as discussed in the associated manuscript.
